purpose: Named cross-team dependencies raised by team4. Each entry names exactly ONE owner. team4 does not implement another owner's scope and does not treat a missing adapter as complete.
recordedBy: team4 lead (MiniMax M3.1 Flash via MiniMax Code)

contracts.need: Port dimabot/src/utils/overlay-token.ts to Rust: overlayTokenHash, storedOverlayToken, manageOverlayToken and readOverlayToken.
contracts.why: The overlay widgets and roulette publish through an overlay token that only team2's module can mint and validate.

blocks: the entire team4 pets runtime lane
contracts.why: team4 owns the pets tree but four of its dependencies have no Rust port, so the lane was deferred to wave 2 rather than authored against an invented API.

blocks: the clearSpeechFiles publish step in the speech/TTS lane
contracts.why: The speech lane's clear-speech-files path publishes through the pub/sub manager.

contracts.need: EventSub activation and unsubscription remote adapters used by the overlay live runtime.
blocks: lane D overlays runtime, the EventSub-driven parts
contracts.why: The overlay live runtime subscribes/unsubscribes on channel events through the existing remote adapters.

contracts.need: Expose a credit balance / availability read to team4's voice preview path.
blocks: lane A speech core, the credit gate of the voice preview
contracts.why: dimabot/src/utils/tts_usage.rs exists and covers usage and pricing, but there is no balance read available to the preview service.

contracts.need: A shared parser-boundary change so a lone surrogate can enter the AST representation: SyntaxEngine::parse accepts &str at dimabot/src/utils/ast_parser/syntax.rs:89 and AstNode::Literal stores String at dimabot/src/utils/ast_parser/types.rs:81.
blocks: lane D overlays runtime, mixed unpaired-UTF-16 alert templates
contracts.why: The existing lossless string utilities (crate::utils::js_string) cannot place a lone surrogate into the current AST representation, so this is a shared-boundary change rather than a lane-local one.

contracts.need: Overlay and pet writers must share the same AssetLibrary instance and owner-lock registry as uploads and deletes.
blocks: lane C media assets, lane D overlays recovery
contracts.why: The source's owner lock is an in-process Map, so it cannot coordinate independent TypeScript processes.

contracts.need: Lease the isolated fixture phase before running the guarded tests and the Node oracles. The lease must provide the shared helper's owner marker (DIMA_RUST_TEST_RESOURCE_OWNER), the keyword-mongo alias, the namespace, a sanitized Node environment and ffprobe.
contracts.why: team4 has no execution lease in this wave, so nothing it authored has been compiled, run or tested.

contracts.need: The *_reference.cjs oracle pattern pins Node v24.22.1 / V8 13.6.233.17-node.58 / typescript 5.9.3 while the host node is v26.8.2. The pinned runtime exists in the isolated oracle container.
blocks: lane C media asset source-comparison oracle
contracts.why: team4's media oracle follows the same convention, so it must be run in the pinned container rather than on the host.

note: Optimization and benchmark work is deferred. React Email is exempt from this team's scope.
